slides.title: Differential Drive Mobile Robot

visualInspection.notes: Front/side drawings distinguish two driven wheels and passive caster. Equal signed wheel speeds give straight motion; opposite signs require equal magnitudes to yield pure in-place rotation under the next page equations. Simplicity and indoor mapping/navigation uses are qualitative. Actual 1800×1013 pixels inspected alongside text.

slides.title: Robot Kinematics and Motion Model
